qs.admin.pings_summary: Qs role: eruption start · eruption end · once per phase after 8 reported destroyed bases. Participants: at phase start in their thread. Start/end notifications missed during downtime are not sent later.
qs.admin.draft_summary: Changes apply only after saving. Phase hours before the eruption start time automatically fall on the following day. Every phase must fit entirely inside the 24-hour eruption.
qs.admin.denied: Only the initiating moderator/officer with message management permissions may confirm. The bot also needs message and thread management permissions.
qs.admin.remove_warning: Remove the Qs tool? All its phase threads, Qs overviews and Qs data in this channel will be permanently deleted. The main channel, unrelated messages and selected role remain.
qs.admin.reset_warning: Start a new Qs cycle? ALL messages (including unrelated and pinned messages) in the main channel and Qs threads will be deleted. Signups and base reports will be cleared. Remaining phase threads are kept; switching from 5 to 4 deletes the fifth thread. The displayed new schedule will be applied.
qs.admin.remove_success: The Qs tool, its threads and data have been removed.
qs.admin.reset_success: The main channel and Qs threads have been cleared. The new Qs cycle uses your selected timestamps.
qs.admin.maintenance_failed: Cleanup or restoration could not be fully completed. Messages/threads may already be deleted and the new cycle may already be saved. Check permissions and run Remove/Reset again. The tool stays locked until cleanup is complete.
